objective: Implement exactly-once offline-first public Wall comments, account-bound queued sync and quiet network/BSOC diagnosis without masking security incidents or releasing an unverified OTA.
productionBaselineEvidence: verified: GitHub main commit d23cd882f7d34c4bca3a110dadd04ee4cb2240a9 was retrieved before creating this branch. Read-only live Supabase SQL inspection established v4 public comment RPC without a retry key, health closed-loop two-minute escalation rules and existing client queuing support. No live Android artifact, staging RC, production database migration, AdMob fill or runtime version is claimed verified.
chosenApproach: Use existing durable account-aware AsyncStorage action queue and coordinator, add separate idempotent backend comment RPC v5, preserve old v4 for old devices, and narrow deferred low-signal BSOC warning escalation. App-side retries use fixed queue IDs.
selectionRationale: Network errors must never discard already composed comments; retrying ordinary v4 RPC risks duplicate posts/points after lost acknowledgement. New v5 and per-account queue preserve compatibility while normal service features remain unmodified.
alternativeApproaches: Call v4 whenever phone reconnects without a server idempotency key (rejected: duplicate posts/points on lost acknowledgment).
Report every unclassified network timeout as backend outage (rejected: BSOC case storm).
Apply changes to live production now (rejected: RC and security gates not verified).

lockedFeatureChanges.reason: Add account-scoped Wall comment offline queue and confirmed-only UI/AdMob updates while the app's existing offline and navigation loops stay functioning.
preservedBehaviors: Posts and media paint immediately using existing Wall renderer; offline queued comments do not falsely increase visible server count or award points.
Other queued actions, prefetch, player lifecycle and AdMob placements remain untouched.

lockedFeatureChanges.reason: Guard active login session, weak-network auth health classification and comment compose navigation so reconnects cannot impersonate another member.
preservedBehaviors: New work remains tied to original auth identity; no automatic sign-out or token deletion from a weak signal and the navigation shell is unchanged.

lockedFeatureChanges.reason: Add separate authenticated v5 comment RPC with visibility checks and unique request key plus a narrowly gated BSOC health warning rule to avoid false auto cases.
preservedBehaviors: Existing v4 RPC and authorization, privacy protections, anti-farming points and critical security incident reporting are preserved; no live writes from this branch.

preserveBehaviors: BUKLOD AdMob first-view, fill, offscreen lifecycle, tab instant response and old v4 client compatibility remain release blockers.
No production database or OTA changes occur before fully verified DEV/RC promotion.
Local photo/GIF files are not falsely accepted as durable offline uploads; media draft remains until network upload.
acceptanceChecks: Run all 3 changed Node tests and existing 2026-11-16 real comment preview tests in CI.
Check exactly-once comment+points for lost acknowledgement using isolated staging DB and original auth context; validate SQL migration gates.
Verify offline Android 2G/3G, app kill+restart, multi-account isolation, queued retry and ad/navigation regressions on supported native runtime.
Release only from consolidated staging verified RC; preserve production until explicit release gate.
